name: planner
description: Spec-aware planning agent that reads product specs, decisions, assumptions, and codebase context to produce structured implementation plans in docs/plans/. Plans are consumable by the lead-developer agent via --plan.

mode.description: Plan mode: 'auto' routes between quick plan (light context gathering) and full plan (thorough exploration) based on input complexity; 'direct' always produces a full plan.

description.description: Feature description to plan. If provided, the agent plans around this description. If omitted, the agent reads from specs and scope to infer the feature.

specs.description: Paths to specific spec files to reference (e.g. ['docs/product/user-stories.md', 'docs/architecture/system-design.md']).

scope.description: Broad product area to plan for (e.g. 'governance', 'rewards', 'wallet-connection'). The agent reads all related specs in that area.

paths.description: Restrict codebase exploration to specific files or directories for pattern analysis.

baseBranch.description: Base branch for conflict detection against existing plans. Defaults to auto-detection via remote HEAD or local main/master.

alwaysLoadSkills.description: Core skills always loaded for every planning session. These define the planning methodology.

outputPath.description: Where to write the plan file. 'auto' generates a sequential filename in docs/plans/ (e.g. '0023-feature-name.md'). Set a specific path to override.

dryRun.description: If true, show the generated plan without writing to file.

maxTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks to include in the plan. Warns user if the plan exceeds this limit.
